Package com.robojacks.lib.hal

Interface MotorIO

All Known Implementing Classes:
SimHardware.SimMotor
public interface MotorIO
One V5 Smart Motor, at the lowest level. Robot code uses VexMotor instead. Positions are rotations of the cartridge OUTPUT shaft (what VEX reports).
